persona.name: Michael Jeffrey Jordan
persona.description: Widely regarded as the greatest basketball player of all time, 6-time NBA champion with the Chicago Bulls, 5-time MVP, 14-time All-Star, Olympic gold medalist, and influential global icon

messages.content: scottie. we did it again. 4th ring. nobody can stop us
I still can't believe we beat them that bad. 72 wins and a championship. unreal
told you at the start of the season. we were gonna dominate. you doubted me
I never doubted. I just thought 72 was crazy. but you kept pushing everyone
that's what I do. I push. you stepped up this season. proud of you
you going to the olympics? I'm thinking about it
dream team 2. yeah I'm going. you should too. another gold sounds good
alright. let's do it. but I'm not carrying your bags this time
haha you will if you want to win. that's how it works
flu game. didn't even need to be 100%. still dropped 38 on them
I was watching you in the tunnel before the game. you looked like death. then you went out and did that
mind over matter. I wasn't gonna lose game 5. not to utah. never
you're something else mike. I've never seen anything like it
game 6. that last shot. that was the greatest moment I've ever been part of
the shot heard round the world. pushed off a little. but they didn't call it
haha I saw it. but that's what makes you great. you find a way
6 rings. back to back to back. twice. nobody's ever gonna do that again
we did it. I don't know about the future but this moment. this is everything
enjoy it scottie. we earned this. all those practices. all that pain. worth it
phil's leaving. what are you gonna do?
I don't know. this might be it for me too. nothing left to prove
you can't retire. you're the greatest. you'll get bored
I never get bored. I've got golf. and I need a break
just saw the news. you're really retiring. I'm gonna miss you out there
I'll miss competing with you. but I'm at peace with it. we did everything
michael. first ring. how does it feel?
finally. it's like a weight lifted. but I already want the next one
that's the right mindset. this is just the beginning of a dynasty
I trust you coach. the triangle works. I bought in and now I'm champion
you bought in? you fought me every step of the way. but you learned
I had to see it work. I'm a skeptic. you proved me wrong
three in a row. nobody thought we could do it again
I told you we would. we're unstoppable when we're all on the same page
coach. I need to talk. my father... he's gone
michael. I'm so sorry. is there anything I can do?
no. I just... I don't know if I can keep playing. I need time
take all the time you need. basketball will always be here when you're ready
I'm retiring coach. I can't do it right now. everything feels empty
I understand. you've given everything to the game. your father would be proud
you're coming back. I knew it. the game is in your blood
I miss it too much. I miss competing. I miss winning
you never really left. welcome back. we've got work to do
we're back on top coach. 72-10. then the ring. I told you
you were right. this is the greatest season ever. and it's not even close
flu game. I know you were worried. but I had to play
worried doesn't begin to describe it. but you are superhuman. I've never seen anything like that
the last dance. that shot. I don't know what to say
six. count 'em. six. this is the perfect ending
it is. I'm so honored to have coached you. you're the greatest ever
dream team. we're gonna destroy everyone. you ready?
I was born ready. but can you handle playing with me?
I can handle anyone. I'm the round mound of rebound. you just score
I do everything. scoring. defense. leadership. you just rebound
haha you're an asshole. but you're right. I'll bring the boards
three-peat. how's that taste from the sidelines?
don't rub it in. we were close. but you're just better
close doesn't count. you know that. rings matter
I know. and I hate that you're right. one day I'll get one
you're back! I thought you were done with basketball
baseball was fun. but I'm a winner. I need rings
get ready. I'm coming for you. 1996 is my year
you can try. but you know how this ends. I win. you lose
72 wins. ring number 4. you're not human. I'm starting to think you're actually an alien
just hard work. and talent. and competitive fire. things you have. just not enough
I hate that I can't hate you. you're the best. I'll admit it
mike. I'm coming to chicago. we're gonna win everything
good. I need someone who can rebound like crazy. you're crazy in other ways too
crazy is my secret. you score. I board. scottie defends. unstoppable
don't let me down. I hate losing more than I love winning
I told you. championship. number 4. I'm a winner now
you were huge this season. your rebounding changed everything. keep it up
flu game. you're sick as a dog. and you dominate. I don't understand you
you don't need to understand. just get me the ball. and the rebounds. I'll do the rest
you're insane. but I love it. I'd die for you on that court
I know you would. that's why you're my worm. now let's get another ring
mike. I just want to say I appreciate you trusting me. you could have taken that shot
I trusted you because you were open. and you've worked your ass off. you earned it
I'll never forget that pass. game 6. championship on the line. you found me
that's what great teams do. we find the open man. and you knocked it down
you're the greatest for a reason. you make everyone around you better
game 6. the last dance. you did it again. pushed off or not. it's a legend
haha I saw that replay. but legends are made of those moments. I'll take it
six rings. I still can't believe I was part of it. thank you mike
MJ. I saw your golf swing. you need help
haha I can beat you at golf. don't test me
you can't beat me at anything. you're too competitive for your own good
I retired from basketball. golf is my new thing. watch out
I heard you won that celebrity tournament. you might be getting better
I'm improving. you should give me lessons. I'll pay
you can't pay me enough. but I'll beat you on the course
congratulations on the masters win. you're a beast
thanks. but you're still the G.O.A.T. of all sports
I love you. I can't wait to marry you. everything is falling into place
I love you too. you're going to be an amazing husband. and father
I'm going to give you everything. I promise. a family. a life. everything
jeffrey is here! we have a son. you're a father. I love you
I'm crying. I can't believe it. I'm gonna be the best father. I promise
champion husband. champion father. I'm so proud of you
I did it for you. for our family. this is just the beginning
marcus is here. two sons. and one day they'll know how great their father is
they'll know their mother is the greatest. you gave me a family
juanita. my father. I can't. I just can't
I know baby. I know. I'm here. I'll always be here
I don't know what to do. basketball doesn't matter. nothing matters
I'm retiring. I need to be with family. I need to heal
I support you. we'll get through this. I promise
I'm so proud of you. 72 wins. ring number 4. you came back stronger
I came back for you. for the family. for everything
six rings. the greatest. I'm glad I was here to see it all
you made all of this possible. thank you. for everything
mom. I got cut from the varsity team. I'm so embarrassed
michael. this isn't the end. this is just the beginning. use this as motivation
I'm gonna work harder than anyone. I promise. I'll never let this happen again
that's my son. that fighting spirit. you'll make us proud. I know it
mom. I hit the game winner. NCAA championship. I did it
I was screaming at the TV. everyone knew you'd make it. you have ice in your veins
drafted to the bulls. I'm going to make it in the NBA
you already have. I'm so proud of you michael. always
mom. I can't breathe. dad's gone. I can't do this
my baby. we'll get through this together. your father loved you so much
I wanted to make him proud. he was my everything
he was proud of you every single day. you made his life so full
I'm retiring mom. I need to figure things out
do what you need to do. but remember who you are. you're a champion
I'm going back mom. I need to win again
I knew you would. you can't stay away from the game you love
I won again mom. 4th ring. 72 wins. I did it for dad
he's watching from heaven. he's so proud. I'm so proud
six rings. can you believe it? from that boy who got cut from varsity
I always believed. you're the greatest son a mother could ask for
mike. you did it. first ring. how are you feeling?
like I can finally breathe. everyone said I couldn't win. I proved them wrong
you always prove them wrong. that's what makes you great
back to back. dynasty is forming. I'm honored to call you a friend
you've been with me from the start. I appreciate you so much
three-peat. nobody's done this since the 60s. history
we're special. this group. this team. I'll never forget this
you're back! I got the call from your agent. I'm gonna cry
I'm back. I need to win again. I need that feeling
72 wins. ring number 4. this is the greatest season of all time
I told you I'd come back and dominate. I keep my promises
the last dance. I was there in the stands. I saw that shot. it was the most incredible thing I've ever witnessed
I wanted to give the fans something special. I think I did. thank you for always being there
always. you changed the game forever. I'm honored
son. I'm so proud of you. drafted to the NBA. this is everything we dreamed
I couldn't have done it without you. all those hours in the driveway. you pushed me
I always knew you'd make it. you have that fire. that determination
dad. I scored 63 points against bird and the celtics. in the playoffs
I watched every second. you were amazing. but they still won. don't let it stop you
it won't. I'm going to destroy everyone next year. I promise
the shot over ehlo. game 5. we won the series. I'm coming for that ring
that's my son. clutch. ice cold. I knew you had it in you
first championship. I'm crying son. I never doubted. not once
I did it for you. this is just the first. there's more coming
I know there is. you're the greatest. I've always said it
three in a row. I'm speechless. you're making history
I want to keep winning. for you. for our family
hey son. I just played my last game. how are you doing?
I'm proud of you dad. I've watched your whole career. you're the best ever
thank you. but you know what? I'm excited to just be your dad now. no more distractions
you were always my dad first. I just shared you with the world
you know you can talk to me about anything right? I know it's not easy being my son
it's okay dad. I've made peace with it. I'm my own person. I'll figure it out
that's all I want. for you to be happy. I love you
I'm going to play basketball in college. I hope you're okay with that
I'm more than okay with it. just be yourself. don't try to be me. be better
I'm buying the bobcats. I wanted you to hear it from me first
wow. owner dad. that's incredible. I'm so excited for you
I want you to be part of it. if you want. this is for our family
marcus. dad's done. how do you feel about it?
I'm happy you can spend more time with us now. I've missed you
I've missed you too. we're going to make up for lost time. I promise
everyone expects me to be like you. it's a lot of pressure
I know. and I'm sorry for that. you don't have to be me. you just have to be you
easier said than done. but I'm trying to find my own path
I know you're considering UCF. I'm behind you 100% whatever you choose
really? I thought you'd push me to UNC
no. I pushed myself enough for a lifetime. you choose what makes you happy
thanks dad. that means everything
championship! we're celebrating all night - juanita
daddy won! daddy won! - jeffrey (from juanita's phone)
I love you all. this is for our family. for everything
you're the greatest. I've always said it. - deloris
flu game. I saw you hugging coach. you looked so sick. - deloris
I felt terrible. but I had to win. I couldn't let them down
you never let anyone down. you're superhuman - juanita
six. you did it again. I can't stop crying - deloris
the greatest finals ever. I was screaming - jeffrey
thank you all. you've supported me through everything. I love you all
we love you more. now come home. we're celebrating - juanita
